capabilities: Browse notes in a tag tree with combined-tag branches and nested tags
Filter visible notes and tags by folder paths and tag glob patterns
Search and open notes by combining or excluding tags
Create new notes with the current tags, optionally from a template
Sort, pin, merge, and add virtual tags to the tree
disambiguation: It does not create or move real folders in the vault; it only shows tags as a virtual folder tree while files stay in place.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; interface available in English and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Obsidian's tags view presents tags as a flat list, so notes sharing several tags cannot be browsed as a narrowing hierarchy of folders.
summary: Sidebar view that displays notes in a virtual folder tree built from their tags, with combined-tag branches, filters, tag-based search, and note creation.
